meta.title: Assets and maintenance · Clafina
meta.description: A register of what the business owns: who holds it, where it is, when it needs service and what it is worth in the books.

hero.title: Know what you own, and keep it working.
hero.lede: Vehicles, machines, computers and fittings in one register. Each one has a place, a holder, a service plan and a value that depreciates in the books every month.

jobs.title: Where it is, and who has it
jobs.body: Every asset has a place and a holder. Moves go through approval, and a scan of its tag opens its page.

jobs.title: Serviced before it breaks
jobs.body: Schedules by date or by meter raise the work order ahead of the day, with parts from stock and labour.

jobs.title: Right in the books
jobs.body: Depreciation is posted each month as one entry. Revaluation, disposal and write-offs post their gain or loss.

tour.title: One page for each asset
tour.body: An asset's page shows its place, its holder, its cover and its value today, with its next service beside them.

faq.q: Can maintenance be planned by running hours instead of dates?
faq.a: Yes. A schedule can follow a date or a meter, such as running hours or kilometres. The work order is raised ahead of the day it is due.

faq.q: Does depreciation post to the books by itself?
faq.a: Yes. The monthly run works out depreciation by the method set for each asset and posts it as one entry.

faq.q: Can technicians record work without a connection?
faq.a: Yes. Field checks on the phone work offline, with photos, meter readings and damage reports, and sync when the phone is back online.
